# يَتَسَلْسَلُ (yatasalsalu) /ja.ta.sal.sa.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَسَلْسَلَ (tasalsala)

# يَتَسَلْسَلَ (yatasalsala) /ja.ta.sal.sa.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَسَ
